body:
A few summers ago at my friends appartment I got curious and found his hand pipe. I had with me a few grams of colts foot (smoked earlier on that day) lettuce opium gum (about 5 -7 grams worth) and a homemade passionflower crystalized extract.
The two extracts were made this way: I took a medium bag of passion flower and soaked it in water in a closet for a period overnight, in the morning I removed the herb from the water and squeezed any water out of the plant material, then left the water for about a day or so to dry out. The lettuce was done in two similar fashions: The first was placing about 20-40 lettuce leaves into a shallow baking dish containing water and leaving it there over night, then squeezing all the liquid out of the leaves and straining it, I then left it to dry for a few days. The second method was juicing the lettuce using a food processor and then squeezing out all the green juice and letting it dry on a plate for a few days.
During the course of the 3 hrs (in one sitting) I had smoked half of the passion flower extract using a hand pipe, I felt mellow and had a mild trip. Then about an hour or so later I slowly and gradually smoked the L.opium resin in the same pipe until each chunk had been burnt down to a small black chunk. (I replace/refilled the pipe and relit it until I had used about half of the black stuff.) Soon I began freaking out & seeing visual hallucinations, the freak out had lasted 2 - 3 hrs or so and my friend had gone out looking for me wondering where I was. When he found me 2 hours later I was still freaking out & he told me what to say and do during the freak out period, by the time night fall hit I had began leveling out/down.
